summary: Sidus Space filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts at-the-market offering of 16,485,038 shares of Class A common stock at $5.08 per share and 3,200,001 pre-funded warrants at $5.0799 per warrant, for up to ~$100M gross proceeds. There is no minimum offering requirement, no escrow, and investors receive no refund if proceeds are insufficient. ThinkEquity acts as placement agent on a reasonable-best-efforts basis. The offering was priced at a 16.6% discount to the prior day's $6.09 close. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for potential dilution and lack of a guaranteed minimum.
